text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, as I was pondering my upcoming schedule...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...Do you have a moment?
It's about our plans... going forward.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
If I enter the race like this...
I fear I may not be able to execute the mission.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
It is all... because of my own shortcomings.
I was unable to adapt to the plan... My apologies.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"In order to... produce results.
I would like to request a revision... to our schedule."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Symboli Kris S is thoroughly exhausted from running consecutive races...
I should reconsider her upcoming race schedule.
